address: 3-4F, Sunshine Plaza, 353 Lockhart Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: An iconic landmark of Wan Chai since 1976, Sang Kee has moved shop. The room is brighter, more spacious and offers more seating. But rest assured: the menu hasn’t changed and the food is as good as ever. Despite the lack of fancy plating and luxury ingredients, you’ll find yourself craving their salt-baked chicken, pork liver and wolfberry leaves blanched in stock, and baked fish intestine with egg long after you’ve gone home....
